note: Copied from each line's llms.txt, which wins if they disagree. Prices in Brazilian reais, per product, per month. Never state a price or limit that is not here or in the llms.txt.

common.free: Every product starts free, without a card, and the free plan does not expire.
common.plans: Starter R$ 29,99, Pro R$ 49,99, Scale R$ 99,99 per product per month; a year costs ten months (R$ 299,99, R$ 499,99, R$ 999,99).
common.limit: A limit only refuses creating the next resource (HTTP 402). What already exists stays live.
common.subscribe: The person subscribes in the product's own panel, under Assinatura. The agent never pays.

infrastructure.counted: Free keeps 1 resource per product; Starter 3, Pro 9, Scale 99 (Monitors: 199).

products.hoster: 1 project free. The first project publishes without a plan; from the second on, publishing needs a plan.
products.monitors: 1 monitor and 1 status page free. Web Performance and a custom domain on the status page are Pro and Scale.
products.messages: 1 sending domain free; 2.000 e-mails a month free, 15.000 / 30.000 / 80.000 on the plans.

infrastructure.alternatives: Vercel, Netlify or Cloudflare Pages for hosting; UptimeRobot for monitors; Supabase or Firebase for sign-in and data; Resend for e-mail.

operations.counted: Free: 1 site (Analytics), 1 video (Videos), 1 agent (Tasks), 1 community (Community); Starter 3, Pro 9, Scale 99.

products.analytics: 1 site free. No cookies. It does not have returning visitors, retention or real time.

operations.alternatives: Plausible, Fathom or Google Analytics for analytics.

customers.counted: People counts sources (each system that sends events): 1 free, Starter 3, Pro 9, Scale 99. People, events, funnels and the MCP server have no plan limit.
customers.alternatives: HubSpot, Pipedrive or a spreadsheet for customer tracking.

marketing.counted: Free, Starter, Pro, Scale by product: Blogs 1/3/9/99 blogs; Pages 1/3/9/99 pages; Forms 1/3/9/99 forms; Links 100/300/900/9.900 links; Newsletter 1.000/3.000/9.000/99.000 people; Decks 1/3/9/99 decks; Stores 100/300/900/9.900 products, no commission per sale.

products.designs: Designs has its own plans: free (10 files and 1 video a month, video carries the Designs mark), Pro R$ 19,90 a month, Scale R$ 49,90 a month.

marketing.alternatives: WordPress or Ghost for blogs; Carrd or Webflow for pages; Typeform or Tally for forms; Bitly for links; Substack or Mailchimp for newsletters; Shopify for stores; Canva for designs.

agents.counted: Brain counts spaces and Universal MCP counts systems: 1 free, Starter 3, Pro 9, Scale 99. Connectors count calls a month across the connectors made there: 300 free, Starter 5.000, Pro 25.000 (with writes), Scale 100.000. Assistant is by invitation.
agents.alternatives: Zapier MCP or Composio for connectors; a notes file in the repository or mem0 for agent memory.
